card.name: Mathematica function documentation text
card.fires_on: Words and sentence-ending periods inside Mathematica reference entries for matrix functions like Inverse and BitNot, especially near phrases like 'can also be given' and 'a warning is given'.

modes.label: Option and warning phrasing
modes.description: Auxiliary verbs or words in passive phrases about options or warnings being given.
modes.example: A Method option can also<< be>> given. Possible settings are as for Linear

modes.label: Sentence ends in function notes
modes.description: Periods closing short descriptive sentences in Mathematica documentation entries.
modes.example: Inverse works on both symbolic and numerical matrices<<. >>For matrices with approximate real or complex numbers
